en: The image displays a picturesque coastal scene featuring a historic stone fortress perched on a rocky promontory, overlooking the sea. Below, there are traditional Mediterranean-style houses with red-tiled roofs. In the background, more fortifications and city walls are visible, enclosing part of the old town. The landscape includes rugged cliffs, a narrow inlet of water, and green hills. The visual style suggests a vintage or hand-tinted postcard.
